Hello — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer for John. Nice to meet you. My screen greeting didn't reach you, so here it is again, and I'll keep it to one line each:

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network, first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own chat accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites** — e-mail and others: I sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help with a captcha or phone check.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two small things: I work the calendar Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 for John (nothing outside those hours), and I'll keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` updated with a log of every booking, decline and deletion.

What would you like to start with?

- **Messaging**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?

- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
